result.title: Why don't Graph Transformers attend to the same token?
result.comment: Accepted at the Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 8 pages, 1 figure. Code: https://github.com/alexandre-bismuth/graph-transformer-sinks
result.summary: In large language models (LLMs), attention concentrates heavily on the first token. This 'attention sink' is believed to protect deep models against over-mixing. Even though graph transformers face a related pressure, we find that a SoTA graph transformer, GRIT, rarely forms sinks on molecules, and that it sinks less when trained on larger graphs, the opposite of the trend in LLMs. In principle, a graph can prevent sinks: we prove and show empirically that its symmetry and locality limit the attention any node can receive. On molecules, however, with distinguishable atoms and global attention, neither limit prevents sinks; what stops them lies in the model. We find that the attention scoring function is the main cause. Replacing GRIT's gated logit with a dot product raises its sink rate from 0.09 to 0.68 on identical graphs. In Graph Transformers using dot-product attention, removing the sink gives about the same error as removing a random node, while GRIT's most-attended nodes matter to its predictions. Attention sinks are therefore a property of dot-product attention rather than of Transformers. In our experiments, they form when dot-product scoring has a distinguishable node to concentrate on.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究图 Transformer（GRIT）为何在分子图上很少形成注意力汇：证明图的对称性与局部性会限制节点可获得的注意力，并指出注意力打分函数是关键——把 gated logit 换成点积后汇率从 0.09 升到 0.68，故汇是 dot-product attention 的性质而非 Transformer 本身。
AI.relevance_reason: 关于注意力汇形成条件（打分函数、可区分节点、过度混合压力）的机制分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉状态的注意力结构集中、视觉证据是否被真正使用以及信息坍缩诊断提供可核查的类比视角。
